full_prompt_en: A square colored woodcut depicts a snowy grove beneath an enormous pale golden sun, with orange-brown trees and a dark winding path. A narrow rust-colored border encloses the scene. The sky is deep teal blue, textured by fine curling carved lines, and a pale crescent-shaped swirl sits in its upper left. On the right, the large round sun rises behind the hills and several bare treetops, occupying much of the background. A cluster of tall trees fills the middle of the image. Their narrow gray-green trunks divide the space into vertical bands, while broad rust and copper crowns overlap as near-circular masses. Fine branching lines spread through those warm canopies. Smaller violet and orange trees recede at both sides. Across the lower half, uneven white snow banks form interlocking curves. Blue-green shade and ochre flecks describe shallow hollows and exposed earth without realistic smooth modeling. A dark brown path or stream enters from the bottom left, bends toward the central trunks, and reappears between snowy slopes on the right. Tiny dark human silhouettes stand or walk among the trees and along the far slope, their scale making the grove feel broad. One figure near the center raises an arm, and smaller silhouettes continue toward the right edge. The light reads as a graphic glow from the oversized sun; the snow is bright cream, while the grove holds muted warm colors and cool blue shadows. There are no long cast shadows, because the colored shapes and carved hatching carry the relief. The printed surface shows close grain, slight irregularity, and layered pigment throughout, especially in the sky and tree crowns. The overall composition balances a huge circular light and rounded foliage against tall trunks and a winding dark line, turning a quiet winter scene into an ornate, rhythmic print.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色木刻描绘巨大的浅金色太阳下的雪中树林，橙棕色树木与深色曲折小路贯穿其间。狭窄的锈色边框围住场景。天空呈深青蓝色，细密卷曲的刻线形成肌理，左上方有一道浅色弯月般的旋纹。右侧，巨大的圆形太阳从山丘和几株光秃树冠后升起，占据背景很大一部分。画面中部是一簇高树。狭窄的灰绿色树干把空间分成竖向色带，宽大的锈色和铜色树冠像近圆形体块般重叠。细细的分枝线在暖色树冠中蔓延。较小的紫色与橙色树木退向两侧。下半幅，不平整的白色雪堆形成相互咬合的曲线。蓝绿色阴影与赭色细屑描绘浅凹和露出的地面，却没有写实的平滑塑形。一道深棕色小路或水流从左下进入，弯向中央树干，又在右侧雪坡间出现。细小深色人形剪影站立或行走于树林和远坡，它们的尺度让树林显得宽阔。中央附近一名人物举起手臂，更多小剪影向右缘延伸。光线表现为来自巨大太阳的图形化辉光；雪是明亮奶油色，树林保留低饱和暖色和冷蓝阴影。这里没有长长的投影，因为色块与刻线承担了起伏感。印刷表面遍布细密颗粒、轻微不规则和叠层颜料，天空与树冠尤其明显。整体构图以巨大的圆形光体和圆润树冠对照高树干与弯曲深线，把安静冬景化为华美而有节奏的版画。
style_prompt_en: The colored woodcut builds an intricate landscape from broad flat pigment shapes, fine carved hatching, and visible printed grain. Deep teal and blue-green fields support warm copper, rust, ochre, and cream accents, with color meeting at mostly crisp but slightly irregular edges. Large circles and rounded masses overlap narrow vertical stems and one sinuous dark line, creating a measured rhythm across the frame. Repeated fine curves give texture inside otherwise simple silhouettes; they also make still areas seem gently animated. Light is conveyed through a concentrated pale disc and bright open planes rather than through realistic gradients or long cast shadows. Tiny dark marks in the middle distance establish scale without competing with the main color geometry. Snowlike pale shapes can be generalized as interlocking light areas that separate warm and cool passages. The overall effect is decorative, handmade, and atmospheric, with print texture and a tightly related palette unifying every layer.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色木刻由宽阔平涂颜料形、细密刻线和可见印刷颗粒构成复杂画面。深青蓝与蓝绿底色支撑暖铜、锈色、赭黄和奶油色重音，各色在大多清晰却略不规则的边缘相接。大圆形与圆润体块覆盖狭窄竖线和一道蜿蜒深线，形成有节制的全幅节奏。重复细曲线为原本简洁的剪影内部增添肌理，也让静止区域仿佛轻轻流动。光由集中的浅色圆盘和明亮开放色面表达，而非写实渐变或长投影。中景细小深色记号建立尺度，却不与主要色彩几何争夺注意。雪一样的浅色形状也可以作为互相咬合的亮区，分隔冷暖段落。整体效果装饰性强、手工感明显且富大气，版印肌理和紧密关联的调色把各层统一起来。
theme_en: A snowy grove beneath a vast pale sun in a colored woodcut
theme_zh: 彩色木刻中，巨大的浅色太阳照着一片雪中树林
name: Gustave Baumann
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
